messages:
Maya Perez: Heads-up — AMS GPU queue spiked at 03:12 UTC, sustained high pending requests for ~9m. Not a full region outage but latency SLOs breached for some customers.
Sanjay Gupta: I'm on it, pulling pod/gpu metrics now. queue depth + pod restarts correlate with a single node group.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260329-ams-gpu-affinity (severity: high) — responders: @sanjay, @maya, @marcus.
Oliver Chen: saw an odd pattern: pod affinity pinned many long-running jobs to two particular racks. Those racks show higher flapping on the fabric.
Priya Nair: confirmed — nic error counters elevated on rack-7 and rack-8. Suggest immediate weighted shift off those racks, not whole region.
Maya Perez: I triggered a conservative weighted shift to IAD and LAX at 03:18 UTC. Shift succeeded but we start seeing egress cost alerting.
Marcus (oncall): Noted. Need to balance SLOs vs cost. Can we throttle low-priority bursts while we investigate affinity rules?
Sanjay Gupta: Changing affinity policy now: reduce preferredDuringSchedulingSeconds to 60 and relax topology spread for long-running jobs. Applying patch in staging, then prod canary.
Maya Perez: Canary applied at 03:26, initial results: queue depth down 40% for affected pools. Latency nearly back to target but a few tail spikes remain.
Oliver Chen: Propose a runbook tweak: add a pre-check to detect high rack-level NIC errors and auto-override affinity before weighted shift to cross-region (to avoid high egress).
Priya Nair: +1. Also add a brief cost-safeguard: when cross-region egress > X in 5m window, lower burst-weight for background classes and only move P1 traffic.
Marcus (oncall): Action item list please. I'll own the post-incident follow-up.
Maya Perez: Action items (from chat):
- Sanjay: push affinity policy change to prod and create an automated check for rack NIC error rate -> PR by EOD.
- Oliver: draft runbook snippet for "rack-level degradation -> affinity override" with exact thresholds and rollback steps.
- Priya: design cost-safeguard thresholds and a kill-switch for cross-region bursts; include metrics to show egress delta.
- Marcus: coordinate customer comms for any customers who saw errors; own RCA timeline.
Sanjay Gupta: Quick notes for PR: config change is this block:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: SchedulerConfig
affinity:
  preferredDuringSchedulingSeconds: 60
  topologySpread:
    - maxSkew: 1
      whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
```
I'll attach perf graphs.
Maya Perez: One more improvement idea: add a short live-check that runs every 2m to evaluate rack-level packet drops and surfaces an "affinity-risk" flag in Console. Would help on-call decide move vs shift.
Oliver Chen: Agree. Also add a note to the playbook: prefer local rebalancing (within-region) before global shifts unless >2 racks affected or node-group health < 70%.
Priya Nair: I'll add test scenarios for this to the chaos lab (rack NIC flaps + high queue) so we can validate automation.
Marcus (oncall): Timeline: write RCA draft by tomorrow AM, runbook PR and automation tickets in backlog. Will assign owners in Jira after this thread.
Maya Perez: Thanks team. Postmortem to include cost delta for cross-region shift, timeline of affinity changes, and the new "affinity-risk" dashboard mock.
ops-bot: Note: follow-up checklist created in INC-20260329-ams-gpu-affinity (link: https://redwood.atlassian/inc/INC-20260329).
Maya Perez: Closing slack thread here; will update when PRs land. :white_check_mark:
